item.title: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise
item.description: Private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates have been compromised, allowing attackers to forge certificates for any site. The keys were revealed due to low entropy, not through a known breach. (3 sources: hackernews, infoq, rprogramming)

item.title: Upcoming Critical PHP Security Release
item.description: PHP is a popular general-purpose scripting language that powers everything from your blog to the most popular websites in the world. (2 sources: frontendfocus, lobsters)

item.title: Compromised LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI Installs a Credential Stealer and Backdoor
item.description: LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI ships a .pth credential stealer and a sitecustomize.py backdoor that run on every Python start. How the implant got in, what it steals, and indicators of compromise. (2 sources: hackernews, lobsters)
